scope: Explicit bounded_pareto orchestration; original until_target and keep gates preserved

verification.cause: New test fixture accidentally encoded literal backslash-n; preserved failed log. No production gate weakened.

guards: Independent DNS/socket denial installed before pytest import
Python audit hook forbids opening actual project .env
All responses use offline MockTransport; no paid provider, GPU or user target execution
Existing PatchEngine isolation retained; patch checks are existing no-network sandbox operations

contracts.default: until_target: first verified kept target ends search
contracts.bounded: Continue original measured-memory improvement loop up to <=6 rounds, preserving all existing numerical and throughput constraints
contracts.selected: Later target regression is reverted; budget/deadline/errors retain successful selected source/verification/artifacts with a partial run status
contracts.evidence: New selected keep cannot display prior after evidence/image; unavailable fresh evidence stops another round
contracts.pareto: Only retained verified configurations; original-source cumulative patches; true dominance filtering; no required tier count

limitations: Synthetic observations are implementation fixtures, not GPU/model acceptance.
Bounded completion means configured rounds were consumed, not exhaustive search or optimality.
No runtime authorization or live budget changed; no PLAN edit or commit.
